The exercise's own maintainer block carries a logged Accept-with-mitigation line (§56): 'no dedicated push-back move for a skipped self-critique ask. Cross-checked the module file one level up: earn-the-trust.md carries the real trainer catch for this exact miss — 'Ex3 default-acceptance on first SKILL.md — student ships Claude's first draft. Trainer runs the self-critique move: "ask the skill to disclose its weakest part before you ship."' — in its Push-back-moves list AND its Per-phase-failure-mode-+-escape-hatch table, plus a Decision-points line protecting the beat from compression. More importantly, the ACTUAL forcing function for this exact move fires one module-section later: earn-the-trust.md's 'Sharpen the skill from evidence' beat runs {{prompt:ae101-m3-sharpen-skill}}, whose fenced text is 'find the ONE section of the skill where invocation evidence shows it underdelivered... Per rule 16's own carve-out ('optional push-backs / refinements ... can live in body') plus the fact that the real mechanism is fenced one section over, this is a maintainer-reconciled, correctly-grounded accept, not an open mechanism gap.
